# homeassistant_area (Data Source)

Reads one area (`config/area_registry/list`), by ID or by name. Exactly one area must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look an area up by name, e.g. to put a device or an entity in it.
data "homeassistant_area" "kitchen" {
  name = "Kitchen"
}

output "kitchen_floor" {
  value = data.homeassistant_area.kitchen.floor_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `area_id` (String) Area ID to look up. Set exactly one of `area_id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Name to look up, compared exactly. Set exactly one of `area_id` and `name`.

### Read-Only

- `aliases` (Set of String) Other names voice assistants accept for the area.
- `floor_id` (String) ID of the floor the area is on; null if it is on none.
- `icon` (String) Icon, e.g. `mdi:sofa`; null if it has none.
- `labels` (Set of String) IDs of the area's labels.
